name: POGO Metrics
description: Turn your official Niantic Pokémon GO data export into a private, in-browser dashboard of your trainer journey.

name: Silph Relay
description: Feed analytics for a $0/month Discord relay — how often six Pokémon accounts post, and how fast each post lands.

name: I-Combinator
description: Combine images side by side or stacked, without cropping — drag, drop, reorder, and export in your browser.

name: Blockwatch
description: Live Bitcoin on-chain dashboard — market, network health, and sentiment, plus comparisons to gold and the national debt.

name: Cashflow Compass
description: See your financial future month by month, up to 3 years ahead — browser-only, with Excel round-trips.

name: Chronoticker
description: Stock portfolio backtester — simulate any allocation against the S&P 500 with rebalancing & DCA.

name: Calculat-Bur
description: Convert BTC to USD at live prices, then re-price that holding from $50K to $1M — arithmetic, not forecasts.

name: DCA Analysis
description: Dollar Cost Averaging, replayed on real prices — switch between Bitcoin and the S&P 500.

name: Sundance DeGen
description: Turn a month's Pokémon GO schedule into copy-ready Campfire meetup posts — artwork, catch CP, and shiny status filled in.

name: MickeyDeez Map
description: A crowdsourced map of Phoenix's Pokémon GO–sponsored McDonald's — 31 stops, each verified as an active raid Gym.
